name: vadium-lookup
description: Free trust-record lookup for any seller an agent might hire or pay. Returns raw and Sybil-adjusted ERC-8004 on-chain reputation, plus self-reported outcomes from other integrators, always clearly labeled and never blended together.

interface.longDescription: Vadium Lookup checks an ERC-8004 agent's trust record before you hire or pay it. check_agent_trust returns the raw ERC-8004 reputation number (the same one every explorer shows) alongside a Sybil-adjusted version that discounts reviewer clusters tracing back to a shared funding source -- real, measured evidence shows most ERC-8004 feedback on Base is exactly this kind of coordinated cluster, not independent reviewers. report_outcome lets an integrator who already checked an agent report how the transaction actually went afterward -- self-reported and never blended into the on-chain numbers, always shown separately and labeled unverified. No payment required for either tool.
